input.quote: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form.
input.rationale: Section 11 meets or exceeds our preferred position: 11.1 gives six months of transition assistance on Customer's request at the expiring Order Form rates (better than "then-current rates" for pricing certainty), 11.2 requires return of all Customer Data within thirty days of request in a complete, documented, machine-readable format and bars withholding for fee disputes, and 11.3 sequences secure deletion and written officer certification only after Customer confirms successful return, with any law-required copy remaining protected. Sections 9, 10 and 15 contain no earlier deletion or data cut-off that would precede retrieval (10.1 preserves access through the agreed transition period and preserves Customer Data rights). No redline needed.
